# Discordian

Discordian brings Discord-style dark visuals to Obsidian with a clean, minimal interface and subtle Discord colors. It aims to stay unobtrusive while remaining compatible with popular community plugins, and a companion Discordian plugin adds optional writer-focused features and finer visual controls.

![Discordian screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/radekkozak/discordian/HEAD/media/screenshots/discordian-full-mode.png)
